title.narrative: Provision of life saving WASH services to 15,000 people ( 3000 Men, 3750 women, 3750 Boys and 4500 Girls) Cholera and Flood affected communities in Belet Hawa District, Gedo Region, Somalia.

description.narrative:
ltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtThe current cholera out- break in Somalia is an attributed to an increasing proportion of drought affected people with no access to safe water and exacerbated by recent floods in Balet Hawa District that caused contamination of water sources increasing number of those affected. The combination of flooding /drought situation have continued to impact the displaced population who have limited access to WASH services, lack of access to hygiene items and lack of proper information on good hygiene and sanitation practices is leading to spread of AWD/Cholera in the district. The Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) in Balet Hawa IDP camps are living in overcrowded settlements with inadequate shelter and WASH services. Health centres in the district have reported a surge in disease outbreaks, including acute watery diarrhea/cholera, and measles cases, which are likely to increase due to the risk of people consuming contaminated water and lack of adequate sanitation and hygiene facilities and serviceslt/spangtltspan style="font-family: Roboto color: black" lang="EN-US"gt.lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gt Cross border activities have also not made it easier for responders.lt/spangtltspan style="color:blackmso-themecolor:text1" lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin-bottom:9.95pt" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtThe cholera situation is further driven by high cases of malnutrition among children under 5 years and limited access to safe water, lack of chlorination in many areas, poor WASH infrastructure at CTC response centers and Open defecation in IDP camps leading to contamination of water are risk factors. Water quality has deteriorated as floodwater transports debris from eroding banks, suspending silt in the water, which can decrease water quality and contribute to toxic algal blooms. Some Shallow wells that supply water to major IDP camps flooded, causing the water to become extremely turbid and contaminated.lt/spangtltspan style="color:blackmso-themecolor: text1" lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin-bottom:9.95pt" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtThe project aims to support 15,000 people ( 3000 Men, 3750 women, 3750 Boys and 4500 Girls) people in belet Hawa district with access to Life saving WASH services. The populations groups being targeted are drought/ floods displaced and AWD/cholera affected Men, Women, Boys and Girls including persons with Disability. Services will target communities and CTC treatment centers including schools where possiblelt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin-bottom:9.95pt" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtIn fulfillment of the Localization Agenda, NCA believes in Nurturing local capacities and training stakeholders for increased ownership on project initiatives while supporting locally led actions. In this intervention NCA will work with district local authority, camp leaders, religious leaders, MoH and MoEWRlt/spangtltspan style="color:black mso-themecolor:text1" lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp class="" style=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gt The WASH response intends to increase access to water in the IDP settlement and host community locations by:ltbrgt
lt/spangtlt/pgtltolgtltli style="margin-bottom:0cmline-height:normalmso-layout-grid-align: nonetext-autospace:none" class="MsoNormal"gtEmergency water trucking for 45 daysltbrgtltspan lang="EN-US"gtlt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="margin-bottom:0cmline-height:normalmso-layout-grid-align: nonetext-autospace:none" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtCommunity Mobilization /Project launchlt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="margin-bottom:0cmline-height:normalmso-layout-grid-align: nonetext-autospace:none" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtRehabilitation of 5 shallow wells lt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtEstablishment lt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gtltspan style="color: black"gtand training of 2 water sources chlorination teams establishment of 5 chlorination check pointslt/spangtlt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US"gt
lt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtCltspan style="font-family:"gtonstruction of 105 lockable emergency latrines with handwashing facilities ,15% of latrines for people with disabilitylt/spangt
ltbrgtlt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtProvision of 2500 standard Hygiene kits (Jerry cans, Soap and sanitary pads, aqua tabs) from cluster supply hub lt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtConstruction of 5 Garbage Pits lt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtProvision of sanitation tools 50 setslt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtTraining 30 hygiene promoterslt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtConduct 6 Hygiene promotion sessionslt/spangtlt/ligtltli style="" class=""gtltspan lang="EN-US"gtConduct Baseline and end line KAP Surveys and Post Distribution Monitoringlt/spangtlt/ligtlt/olgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gtltspan lang="EN-US"gt ltbrgt Exact project locations are as belowltbrgt
